comment: Phase 4 cycling Reel + photo-day idea bank. Categories mirror what the account audit says wins: listicle tips (top saves), relatable identity humor (top engagement), advocacy (top reach/shares), Black cycling history (proven with Major Taylor). Add ideas freely; cycling-topics.mjs tracks usage in cycling-topics-used.json (gitignored) so nothing repeats until the bank cycles. An optional "photo" field pins a specific brand_assets/Fotos basename (see INVENTORY.md §3a jersey catalog) so photo-day.mjs forces that exact real photo via JORGE_CAROUSEL_PHOTO instead of leaving the pick to Claude's inventory judgment — used for jersey-specific stories where the visual IS the point.
